text:
tess: Quick flag  noticed Console shows the deprecation banner and a v2 slice for tenant 'zephyr', but their quota graph spikes because billing attributed tokens to v1. Customer upset. Anyone seen banner->badge causing user confusion / quota churn?

omar: Yep. We've been surfacing client header (X-API-Version) in the UI for speed. Routing can and does rewrite to compatible older variants for a subset of requests (fallbacks). That mismatch is the root cause.

viv: Example trace for tenant zephyr: 
```
2025-07-02T11:22:10Z req=tx9 header:X-API-Version=v2
2025-07-02T11:22:10Z router.decide req=tx9 model=redwood-v1 reason=fallback_max_seqlen
2025-07-02T11:22:11Z exec.start req=tx9 model=redwood-v1
2025-07-02T11:22:11Z billing.emit req=tx9 billed_model=client:v2 tokens=412
```
Console badge = v2 but actual exec & router = v1; billing used client tag.

joel: Legal/product note: we cannot silently rewrite invoices at scale. We need an audit trail and an opt-in preview workflow for tenants (or silent corrections under a small dollar/percent threshold).

viv: Tech idea: add router-populated header X-Attributed-Model (or event field attributed_model) that is set as soon as routing decision is final. Then: console and billing consumers adopt precedence rules: attributed_model > billed_model_field > client_header. Also expose an "attribution_mode" badge in UI so tenants know what view they're looking at.

omar: Implementation nuance: attributed_model may arrive slightly later than fastpath events. Two rollout options: (A) delay UI badge until router decision (worse UX) (B) keep fastpath badge but show low-confidence state until router confirms. I prefer (B) + a shadow reattribution pass.

tess: +1 B. UX suggestion: show a small shield icon with tooltip: "Attribution: post-route (recommended) / pre-route (fast). Click to toggle." Defaults to pre-route for minimal UI latency, but we can flip for tenant cohorts.

joel: Reconciliation plan: 1) Emit attributed_model in events (nullable) for 72h; 2) Run batch reprocess for last 30 days generating delta CSV (tenant, old_tokens, new_tokens, pct_change, est_delta_usd, sample_req_ids) 3) For deltas > 1% or >$25 mark review; legal/revops approve fixes; silent-correct below thresholds. Keep append-only audit file.

viv: Operational detail: in the streaming telemetry pipeline we'll implement a req_id keyed join with a 8s buffer window to attach attributed_model to the fastpath metrics. To avoid memory blowup, we'll: - shadow-join 5% of traffic first - sample 1% for full 30d reprocess - reserve full join only for curated cohorts. Perf sim scheduled.

omar: Also add telemetry metric: attribution_mismatch_rate (per-tenant p95) and join_latency_p99. If mismatch_rate > 2% for 30m or join_latency_p99 > 12s, pause global roll and page infra.

tess: UX copy for badge tooltip draft: "This badge shows the model version reported by the client for speed. Actual executed model may differ if runtime falls back; click to view post-route attribution."

joel: Communication plan for tenants: preview reports for impacted tenants (pct_change > 0.5%) with example lines, no invoice changes until ops signoff. Provide a dispute link. Legal signs off on proposed silent-correct thresholds: pct < 0.5% OR est_delta < $15.

billingbot: Created ticket BILL-1407 "attribution-attributed_model-field+reconcile" assigned to @viv and @omar. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/BILL-1407

viv: Next steps: 1) schema PR to add attributed_model+attribution_mode flags to telemetry events (omar) 2) UI PR for badge + toggle + tooltip (tess) 3) perf sim and shadow-join 5% (ops) 4) batch reprocess job + delta CSV generator (billing team) 5) comms draft for tenants > threshold (joel). Aim for shadow run in 48h.

omar: I'll open the schema PR today and include a compatibility flag so downstream consumers ignore the new fields until toggle on.

tess: i'll draft the UI copy and mockups and post in thread. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
